scope.summary: Implement fitting: fit-content-to-frame, fit-frame-to-content, fit-content-proportionally, fill-frame-proportionally, center-content, clear-fitting, plus a stored frame content-fit rule (scale-to-max-fit, scale-to-min-fit, stretch-to-fit, none) and an anchor point for placed content; fitting MUST be expressible as an object-style property (MT-170). Implement clipping and masking of placed content: applying an embedded clipping path, detecting edges, using an alpha channel, or a frame-as-mask, feeding BOTH display clipping AND the text-wrap contour source (MT-157).
acceptance_criteria: all fitting modes + stored fit rule + anchor as object-style property; clipping/masking feeds display + wrap contour
expected_tests: live: each fitting mode + stored content-fit rule + anchor point positions placed content
test: clipping via embedded-path/edge-detect/alpha/frame-as-mask clips display AND supplies text-wrap contour

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Fitting, clipping & masking

risk_if_missed: Placed content cannot be sized/cropped; masking and contour-wrap unavailable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
